# Document Templates

This folder contains canonical document templates used across all stages of BUS-629.

## Purpose

Templates here serve as the starting structure for written deliverables in `docs/`. Following a shared template ensures consistent formatting, required sections, and professional presentation quality across all memos, specs, and plans.

## Contents

| Template | Description | Used In |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| _(course templates referenced below)_ | See the instructor's canonical templates | Stages 2–5 |

## Reference Templates

The canonical templates for this course live in the instructor's repo:

- **Memo / Decision template**: [`docs/templates/portfolio/`](https://github.com/adamwstauffer/shidler/tree/main/docs/templates/portfolio)
- **Bio template** (with LLM revision prompts): `bio-template.md`
- **Resume template** (Penn-style): `resume-template.md`

Copy and adapt from the course repo as each stage requires.

## Naming Convention

Saved documents in `docs/decisions/`, `docs/specs/`, and `docs/plans/` should follow the pattern:

```
YYYY-MM-DD-{slug}.md
```

Example: `2026-05-19-nguyen-mwg-selection.md`
